channel.description: Parts for the MP4 and MP5 Mercedes-Benz Actros

item.g:title: Service Filter Kit – 5 Filters for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 OM471/OM473
item.g:description: Everything for a standard oil service in one box: engine oil filter, fuel filter kit, fuel pre-filter / water separator, engine air filter and cabin pollen filter. $20 less than buying them separately, and over $250 so shipping is free.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Engine Oil Filter for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 OM471/OM473 – OE A 472 184 04 25
item.g:description: Engine oil filter element for the OM471 / OM473. Change at every oil service. Replaces OE A 472 184 04 25, A 472 184 05 25, A 472 180 03 09, A 472 180 01 09, A 473 180 00 09. Cross-reference: MAHLE OX 832D, MANN HU 12 001 z, Hengst E510H07 D129, LP5090, P7505.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Fuel Filter Kit for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 OM471/OM473 – OE A 471 090 27 55
item.g:description: Main fuel filter kit for the OM471 / OM473: filter element, small mesh pre-strainer and O-rings. Keeps dirt out of the injection system. Change at every service. Replaces OE A 471 090 27 55, A 471 090 24 55. Cross-reference: MAHLE KX 581KIT, MANN PU 12 002-2 z, Hengst E445KP D314-2.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Engine Air Filter for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 OM471/OM473 – OE A 004 094 69 04
item.g:description: Engine air filter element. Check at every service and replace when the restriction indicator shows. Replaces OE A 004 094 69 04, A 004 094 68 04. Cross-reference: MAHLE LX 5437, MANN C 50 004/1, Hengst E2059L.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Cabin Pollen Filter for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 – OE A 960 830 02 18
item.g:description: Cab pollen filter for the heater and air conditioning on the MP4 / MP5 cab. Replace yearly or when airflow drops. A carbon version (A 960 830 01 18) is also fitted to some trucks, so send us your VIN if unsure. Replaces OE A 960 830 02 18. Cross-reference: MAHLE LA 1006.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: AdBlue Pump Filter for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5
item.g:description: AdBlue (urea) pump filter. A blocked filter can trigger an emissions warning and power loss.
item.g:google_product_category: Vehicles & Parts > Vehicle Parts & Accessories > Motor Vehicle Parts

item.g:title: Fuel Pre-filter / Water Separator for Mercedes-Benz Actros MP4 / MP5 OM471/OM473 – OE A 960 477 00 03
item.g:description: Spin-on fuel pre-filter / water separator can for the OM471 / OM473, supplied with a new O-ring. Traps water and coarse dirt before the main fuel filter. Change at every service and drain water as needed. Replaces OE A 960 477 00 03. Cross-reference: MAHLE KC 505D, MANN PL 420/7 x, Hengst H356WK.
